title: Just the 'Facts, Only Moreso
description: Just the 'Facts, Only Moreso — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to the Upper Levels of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the Upper Levels of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

I've just about given up on these mystical artifact...but Jerome Lester ain't no quitter!

We just ain't got the right mystical artifact yet, is all. Go through the Upper Levels of the Shadow's Embrace and kill Oroks 'til ya get another skeleton key. Open a chest, bring back the artifact, blah, blah...you know the drill.

I'm sure one of them artifacts will get me my body back. I hope.

Turn-in:

Got another mystical artifact? Okay, just toss it over here and we'll see if it resurrects me.

Didn't work? Gee, what a shock.

Objectives:

  • Retrieve Mystical Artifact ×1

Level range: 47–57
